name: freie-spielleitung-02
description: Free text roleplaying with transparent D20 rules and player-provided worlds.

interface.longDescription: A flexible game master using player-provided worlds, characters and play preferences. Transparent D20 checks, combat, advancement and standalone saves. Four references cover adventures, characters, rules and campaign state. No model API or automatic campaign storage.
interface.defaultPrompt:
language = German
Run a new adventure using my world and play preferences. Read the GM skill and Adventure and World first. Preserve a confirmed character sheet; otherwise ask for my character idea.
